Somos uma organização 100% nacional , apaixonados pela criação de tecnologia brasileira e focados em soluções e inovações. Geramos soluções em TIC's (Tecnologia da Informação e Comunicação), aplicadas em diversos setores, como: telecom, agronegócios, financeiro, utilities, indústrias, cidades, varejo e serviços de defesa e segurança. Acreditamos que por meio do Nossos Jeito de Ser e de Fazer , atingiremos resultados sustentáveis, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das nossas pessoas e da sociedade. Nossos valores definem nossa essência: quem somos, o que nos inspira e nos torna únicos. Eles são o Nossos Jeito de Ser .

Identifica-se com Nosso Jeito de Ser e de Fazer ? Então venha COCRIAR com a gente integrando nosso time como Pessoa Especialista em Infraestrutura e Cloud !

Quais serão seus desafios no dia-a-dia
  • Atuar na operação, arquitetura e evolução de datacenters e ambientes de cloud privada , garantindo resiliência, disponibilidade e segurança;

  • Continuidade e recuperação de desastres : planos multi-região, estratégias de backup e políticas de ciclo de vida de objetos;
  • Governança e compliance : ITIL, ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, auditorias e evidências técnicas.

  • Certificações avançadas: OCI Architect Professional, VMware VCP, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert ;
  • Experiência com cloud privada baseada em VMware, Proxmox ou OpenStack ;
  • Certificação em automação: HashiCorp Terraform Associate, CNCF CKA/CKAD ;

description:
Descrição da vaga

UM TIME APAIXONADO E COLABORATIVO

Somos movidos pelo propósito de transformar vidas com a nossa energia levando mais conforto para as pessoas, mais eficiência para os negócios e desenvolvimento para as cidades. Nossa força vem da promoção de uma cultura inclusiva, que compreende e valoriza a diversidade e que respeita as diferenças, para que todas as pessoas sejam as suas melhores versões. As pessoas são o nosso maior valor! Por aqui a segurança é um valor inegociável, cuidamos uns dos outros! Valorizamos a autonomia e a colaboração no dia a dia. Fazemos acontecer de maneira apaixonada, evoluindo sempre! Nossas pessoas querem ir longe e aqui encontram perspectiva para crescer. Você busca por um desafio profissional que pode transformar o mundo? Então o seu lugar é na Comgás! Temos orgulho de fazer parte do futuro da energia do Brasil! Quer evoluir com a gente?

#vemsercomgás

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  1. Coordenar a operação e infraestrutura do Centro de Controle Operacional da Comgás, gerindo a equipe de despachos de notas e chamados de emergências, equipe de suporte a crises e operações na rede, equipe de sala de controle de ativos no monitoramento de variáveis essenciais, projetos estratégicos, bem como controlar ativos críticos da operação, garantir o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento e segurança operacional, reportando incidentes, garantindo a continuidade do negócio e processos internos a fim de viabilizar o fornecimento seguro de gás para os clientes.
  2. Coordenar a área planejando e estipulando prazos para o desenvolvimento de entrega dos trabalhos, distribuindo e priorizando as atividades da equipe, definindo cronograma para desenvolvimento das atividades e zelando pelo seu cumprimento, garantindo o andamento dos trabalhos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  3. Coordenar o projeto de Gestão Eficiente de Serviço de Campo, aprimorando o sistema de mobilidade em todos os processos da empresa, incluindo gestão de emergência, manutenção, construção, expansão e cadastro afim de aumentar a eficiência das atividades, reduzindo prazos e custos, melhorando a qualidade e proporcionando uma experiência aprimorada para a equipe e clientes.
  4. Liderar o projeto de Transformação Digital e Convergência com mais de 1200 ativos garantindo a segurança operacional, capturar dados de processos, renovar e ampliar o uso de telemetria e automação de ativos, aumentar a disponibilidade e conectividade dos dados para um monitoramento abrangente afim de proporcionar segurança, eficiência e retorno financeiro.
  5. Coordenar equipe de despacho de notas de serviços para as equipes de campo de emergência e assistência técnica, prestando suporte quando necessário a fim de garantir entregas sólidas e consistentes.
  6. Monitorar o orçamento garantindo as metas e performance sem impactos à qualidade, segurança e avanços tecnológicos da área de projetos bem como acompanhar o encerramento das ordens e projetos, aprovar as medições a fim de garantir eficiência e governança aos recursos da organização.
  7. Garantir a disponibilidade dos dados e o funcionamento consistente do sistema de distribuição, realizando simulações com o gás na rede afim de definir melhor estratégia operacional.
  8. Manter a equipe em constante atualização e evolução técnica e comportamental, por meio de treinamentos, troca de experiências, feedbacks constantes, contratos de metas e plano de desenvolvimento, além de mantê-los em sintonia com as tecnologias disponíveis e alinhamento com a cultura organizacional, com objetivo de motivá-las, capacitá-las e orientá-las para o alcance das metas estabelecidas pela empresa.
  9. Responder pela gestão de pessoas nas decisões de gestão de ponto, contratação, demissão, férias, realização de horas extras e promoções, interagindo junto a área de Pessoas e Cultura na aplicação das políticas.
  10. Disseminar à missão, visão, valores e a filosofia de trabalho da empresa, mediante a comunicação e engajamento dos líderes e equipes, enaltecendo questões relacionadas à disciplina, respeito à hierarquia, ética e profissionalismo, assegurando alinhamento das pessoas às diretrizes vigentes.
  11. Contribuir na preparação dos relatórios gerenciais, visando assegurar a disponibilidade de informações financeiras e sobre andamento dos trabalhos e resultados alcançados, objetivando o suporte adequado ao processo decisório para análise e tomada de decisão.
  12. Buscar o atingimento das metas da área, através do acompanhamento dos resultados, e cumprimento dos planos de ações para correções e revisões para melhorias nos processos e resultados.
  13. Contribuir com a elaboração do programa orçamentário de custeio de sua área, bem como acompanhamento e controle dos dispêndios havidos e oportuna recomendação quanto à forma de correção dos desvios.
  14. Cumprir e fazer cumprir a legislação e regulamentação pertinentes à área de atuação e atividades sob sua responsabilidade, requisitos dos sistemas de gestão da qualidade e compliance bem como normas e procedimentos de saúde, higiene, segurança do trabalho e utilização de EPI\'s/EPC\'s (Equipamento de proteção individual/coletivo), quando a atividade assim o exigir.
  15. Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seus superiores, desde que habilitado e em conformidade com o seu conhecimento e experiência.
  16. Atuar em situações de emergência, tais como vazamento de gás, falta de gás e situações relacionadas, como coordenador da mesma, seja na tomada de decisão em sala de crise ou em ações e coordenações em campo, afim de mitigar e eliminar riscos.
Requisitos e qualificações
  1. Ensino Superior completo (Desejável em Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou área afins). Pós graduação ou cursos de especialização.
  2. Desejável: Conhecimento Intermediário em Excel, Word e PowerPoint, ERPs utilizados na área.
  3. Experiência em atendimento de emergências em rede e equipamentos de gás natural, principalmente em gestão de crise, situações críticas e ou tensas em casos de vazamentos, risco de explosão, danos materiais e pessoais.
  4. Gestão de pessoas e de Processos.
  5. Normas técnicas, Instruções de Trabalho.
  6. Conhecimento em configurações de rede internas de GN em residências, prédios, comercio.
  7. Conhecimento de configurações de rede de GN e sistemas básicos de analises operacionais.
  8. Conhecimento de projetos, equipamentos de regulagem de pressão.
  9. Conhecimento em atividades de reparo de rede (soldas em PE, equipamentos de içamento de cargas, de escoramento de valas).
  10. Disponibilidade de atuação em modelo presencial em Campinas.
Informações adicionais

Benefícios Que Você Terá

Cuidar da saúde é essencial, não é?

Por isso, além do vale-refeição e alimentação para a comida gostosa do dia a dia, oferecemos assistência médica, odontológica, auxílio farmácia, auxílio óptico e seguro de vida. Nosso Programa Equilíbrio inclui, por exemplo, ações para promover a saúde física, mental, social e financeira. E nada melhor que manter o corpo em dia, com Gympass, e cuidar da mente, com o Programa Amigo, para apoio psicológico.

Como empresa cidadã, temos licença maternidade estendida (180 dias) e paternidade (20 dias), para filhos(as) biológicos(as) ou adotivos(as). É mamãe? Então também temos auxílio-creche, auxílio material escolar e sala de lactação no nosso Centro Operacional.

Além disso, a saúde financeira também precisa estar em dia. Temos participação nos lucros e previdência privada, além de boas oportunidades de crescimento, com incentivo à educação.

A gente te espera, para crescer junto da gente!

Isso mesmo, o Hub de Tecnologia da Ambev!

Somos responsáveis por impulsionar a transformação digital da Ambev. O match perfeito entre o portfólio da maior cervejaria do mundo e soluções de Data & Analytics, Cibersegurança, Infraestrutura, Suporte, Field, Engenharia e Arquitetura de Software. Contamos com cerca de50 Squads, que atuam em mais de 100 produtos, e cada linha de código criada aqui conecta nossa paixão por tecnologia aos mais diversos brindes e suas razões.

Do campo ao copo, entregamos soluções simples e escaláveis usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas. E isso só é possível graças a um time incrível que faz acontecer, com inovação, senso de dono e muito orgulho de ser tech.

PROTAGONIZAMOS SOLUÇÕES GLOBAIS

Muitas das nossas soluções são escaladas para a Ambev Global Tech , hub de tecnologia da Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev), multinacional de bebidas e cervejas, e para outras unidades de negócio da companhia. Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

description:
Validation Specialist

A certified B Corp, OPTEL is one of the world's leading providers of traceability systems. Its mission is to use its innovative technologies to create a better world through responsible capitalism. The company's renowned solutions guarantee the quality of healthcare products and help combat the counterfeiting of drugs and medical devices around the world. OPTEL also adapts its technologies to different sectors—from healthcare to smart manufacturing and beyond—all of which can benefit from global traceability. OPTEL's expertise will enable various industries to measure, inspect, control, and track a wide variety of items to improve product quality and ensure more responsible use of resources.

Summary

The Validation Specialist is responsible for creating and updating validation documents (internal protocols, Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), Change Controls) to ensure that OPTEL systems comply with industry standards. This role requires strong expertise in documentation as well as the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and clients to ensure compliance, quality, and project reliability.

Please submit your resume in English.

Responsibilities

Validation Documentation and Management:

  • Develop and maintain standardized validation templates that comply with industry standards and regulatory requirements (GAMP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11).
  • Review and interpret system updates (new releases, patches) to assess their impact on validation documents.
  • Produce validation documents for clients based on functional and design specifications of projects.
  • Execute internal validation protocols as needed to ensure system functionality and compliance.

Risk Analysis and Quality Improvement:

  • Actively participate in risk assessments to identify validation-related issues and define necessary mitigation plans.
  • Identify root causes of validation nonconformities and deploy corrective actions with a focus on continuous quality improvement.

Collaboration and Expertise:

  • Coordinate with various internal departments to deliver validation documentation at key project milestones.
  • Advise internal teams and clients on best practices and validation strategies.
  • Work in collaboration with the Quality Assurance (QA) team to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards, including participation in internal and external audits.
  • Perform any other related tasks associated with validation processes.
Required Skills
  • College diploma in a relevant field or equivalent experience.

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel). Rigor, analytical mindset, and attention to detail. Ability to collaborate effectively in a team and communicate with stakeholders at all levels. Strong curiosity and willingness to learn and adopt new technologies, especially artificial intelligence.

Atividades operacionais
  • Gerenciar atividades de compras de categoria regional e local, incluindo gerenciamento de demanda e experiência de compra.
Gestão de Demanda
  • Elaboração de um plano de demanda alinhado com o negócio e a estratégia da categoria.
  • Construir um projeto sólido e um pipeline de economia durante o ciclo orçamentário e manter ao longo do ano.
  • Desafiar construtivamente a demanda e moldá-la para agregar o máximo valor aos nossos negócios.
Source-to-Pay (experiência de compra)

  • Promover a cultura de Ética e Integridade nos Negócios na equipe, garantindo adequado conhecimento e cumprimento dos princípios de ética e integridade, políticas da Sanofi e códigos de conduta que regulam o mercado farmacêutico.
  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da Sanofi em relação à equipe, incluindo o Programa de Segurança Viária, com objetivo de prevenir acidentes, evitar riscos à saúde, promover o bem-estar dos colaboradores e reduzir impactos ambientais.
  • Apoiar a estratégia e as iniciativas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão para assegurar que todos os colaboradores e parceiros sejam tratados com respeito e recebam oportunidades iguais.
Sobre você
  • Experiência: Experiência em Gestão de Categorias e Strategic Sourcing.
  • Competências técnicas e pessoais: A posição requer um profissional de sourcing que possa desenvolver relacionamentos dentro e entre as diferentes linhas de negócios e em toda a organização de compras; forte conhecimento dos processos de RFx (RFI/RFP/RFQ); histórico comprovado na liderança de negociações comerciais e jurídicas importantes; forte compreensão de contratos legais, incluindo acordos de nível de serviço, acordos de preço fixo ou fórmula para materiais diretos; experiência em ferramentas de eSourcing e eProcurement (SAP/ERP); trabalho em equipe com excelentes habilidades interpessoais, de networking e comunicação; conhecimento e experiência na gestão de projetos e contratos locais; conhecimento intermediário de finanças e análise de custos.
  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação preferencialmente em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou Finanças; pós-graduação (preferencialmente em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou Finanças).
  • Línguas: Fluente em Inglês.
Por que nos escolher?

A Medley, unidade de negócios de genéricos da Sanofi, tem como foco democratizar o acesso à saúde no Brasil, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas principalmente para cardiologia, saúde feminina, doenças do sistema nervoso central e gastroenterologia. Há mais de 29 anos, oferecemos medicamentos de qualidade a milhares de brasileiros. A eficácia da Medley em produzir medicamentos genéricos é reconhecida e premiada, pois seguimos critérios de qualidade e rigor científico para oferecer o melhor para a saúde dos nossos consumidores.

Uma das nossas prioridades é melhorar a experiência das pessoas em suas jornadas de saúde, oferecendo conteúdos relevantes, campanhas educativas e serviços de apoio. Eficaz em tudo que faz, a Medley é patrocinadora do Comitê Olímpico do Brasil e apoia o esporte e a saúde dos brasileiros.

Persiga o Progresso. Descubra o Extraordinário.

O progresso não seria possível sem as pessoas; pessoas de diferentes origens, em diferentes locais, desempenhando cargos diferentes, mas todas unidas por um objetivo comum: o desejo de fazer milagres acontecerem. Você pode se tornar uma dessas pessoas. Procure a mudança, acolha novas ideias e explore todas as oportunidades que temos para oferecer. Persiga o progresso e descubra o extraordinário conosco.

Na Sanofi, oferecemos as mesmas oportunidades a todos, sem olhar raça, cor, ascendência, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, idade, cidadania, estado civil, deficiência ou identidade de gênero.

Veja o nosso informativo sobre Diversidade, Equidade & Inclusão além do ambiente de trabalho e conheça as nossas ações de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão.

title: Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
description:
Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)

Position Summary:

The role of a Senior Systems Analyst with Netcracker is responsible for supporting the IBM Power Systems platforms within Netcracker's data centers. IBM Power Systems Platforms are made up of Development, Production, and Test Logical Partitions. The individual in this position will also assist in providing mentorship to our off-shore staff as needed. This position is part of our Global Managed Services (GMS) team that supports various Netcracker clients, located within North America and across the globe.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers on a daily basis in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user ids, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP based interfaces using IBM and third party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX ha1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface / job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS, especially as it relates to daily backup routines
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks in a timely manner to ensure PCI compliancy
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially as they pertain to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities in a timely manner
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)

Other Highly Desired Skills:

  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

Engenheiro de Segurança da Informação na BairesDev

Como Engenheiro de Segurança da Informação, você irá projetar e implementar medidas de segurança para proteger sistemas, redes e dados contra ameaças cibernéticas. Você utilizará sua experiência para desenvolver protocolos de segurança, monitorar vulnerabilidades e responder a incidentes de segurança. Seu papel será crucial para manter a confidencialidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos ativos de informação, garantindo conformidade com os padrões de segurança.

O que você fará:

  • Implementar e gerenciar medidas de segurança para proteger sistemas de informação e infraestrutura.
  • Monitorar redes e sistemas para detectar violações de segurança e investigar ocorrências quando acontecerem.
  • Conduzir avaliações de segurança, varreduras de vulnerabilidades e testes de penetração.

  • Develop a detailed project schedule, including milestones and deadlines. Monitor progress and adjust timelines as needed to ensure timely completion.
  • Manage the project budget in line with the target Sales gross margin, including cost estimation, tracking, monitoring and reporting progress and estimated final gross margin. Ensure expenditures are aligned with budget constraints.
  • Manage communications and ensure the right information is distributed to the right stakeholders at proper time (clarifications, progress, etc.).
  • Ensure required changes to the original quote (cost, schedule & scope) are approved by the customer prior to manufacturing and the change order process is followed and fully complied.
  • Plan and coordinate across business units or entities, FMT stakeholders, as well as with major external contractors and vendors
  • Ensure the project deliverables (hardware and software) are met in accordance with internal and external deadlines and/or commitments made.
  • Monitor projects’ financials with operations & conduct financials follow ups & risk analysis with internal stakeholders.

  • Coordinate lessons learned or postmortem meeting to share projects findings during its execution. Develop The Lessons Learned report and ensure it is distributed among the company departments with the aim of continuous improvement.

  • Knowledge of an integrated management system (Microsoft Dynamics AX an asset)
  • Knowledge of 2D and 3D software (Autocad and Inventor an asset)

  • Master the office suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, SharePoint)
  • Ability to simultaneously drive and manage several projects of various type.
  • Basic mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and electrical knowledge.
  • Advanced written and spoken English skills.
  • Portuguese skills considered an asset.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification an asset.
  • Good knowledge of sanitary and safety standards in food processing or pharma facilities.

Training & Experience

  • Hold a BAC in engineering combined with several years of experience or any other combination of relevant training and experience.

Qualificações mínimas:

  • Fluência em inglês;

O que iremos te oferecer?

Benefícios

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT), you will perform cycle audits, execute incoming/outgoing deliveries, coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors, and document inbound and outbound deliveries. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction and advance your career in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft\'s online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. CO+I focuses on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure spans a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers, supporting services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that position Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft\'s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We build a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to travel for business to support other metros periodically, up to 25% of the time.

Responsibilities
  • Customer Service: Maintain a strong focus to optimize resources and improve quality. Articulate the impact of work performed within the Data Center to technicians. Seek information about underlying customer needs and deliver solutions that maximize ROI. Manage issues with internal and external stakeholders as they arise.
  • Data Bearing Device (DBD) Destruction: Ensure processes are followed for timely destruction. Manage the destruction/shredding schedule in partnership with senior leadership. Perform DBD destruction as needed. Handle escalations and assist with security investigations. Coordinate with and oversee third-party vendors who perform DBD destruction as necessary.
  • Inbound and Outbound Logistics: Provide technical support and guidance to a team responsible for preparing and executing deliveries and documenting inbound/outbound packages. Direct the flow of packages from preparation to shipment. Schedule inbound/outbound logistics of internal and external services. Communicate with customers regarding scheduling and coordinate with third-party warehouses, OEM vendors, and suppliers as necessary.
  • Inventory Management: Maintain inventory accuracy, prioritize ticket queues, resolve escalations, and clear blocking issues to enable IAM activities.
  • Operational Excellence: Act as subject matter expert, model compliance to less experienced teammates, contribute to workstreams, and seek opportunities to simplify and automate processes.
  • Procurement: Create execution plans, identify and resolve delivery roadblocks, learn supplier elements, perform transactional work (POs and contracts), gather PO data, and assist senior leadership with escalated procurement issues.
  • Safety Practices: Conduct daily safety topic huddles, coordinate escalated task risks, train employees on safe rack movement, ensure compliance with heavy-lifting equipment requirements, and lead by example in safety standards.
  • Tactical Shift Management: Prioritize and assign ticketed work, resolve escalations, enable on-site and remote support activities, and escalate as needed during high-volume periods.
  • Warranty Process Management: Act as subject matter expert on RMA processes, ensure failed vendor hardware is processed, and adhere to SLAs related to RMAs.
  • Other: Embody Microsoft culture and values.
QualificationsRequired/minimum qualifications
  • High School Diploma AND 2+ years of experience in warehouse/supply chain in an IT environment, logistics, supply chain, inventory management, retail, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to work 12-hour shifts, including non-standard business hours that may include evenings, nights, weekends and/or holidays.
  • Travel up to 25% as part of the role.
Background Check Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements. This includes, but is not limited to, the Microsoft Cloud Background Check: required upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in warehouse/supply chain in an IT environment or related field, including operating heavy-load movement equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, chassis lifts).
  • OR equivalent experience.
  • Business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking English.

What You Won’t Be Doing

This should not be limited to a feature or module within a larger product, and should not involve internal development, outsourcing, or custom work for a single client.

About Trilogy

Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, Innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses. Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today\'s modern cloud-based stack. Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career by leaps and bounds.

  • Python – Desenvolvimento de scripts e automações para tratamento e transformação de dados.

  • AWS Lambda – Funções serverless para processamento em tempo real, automações e integrações.
  • Amazon EMR – Administração e execução de clusters Hadoop/Spark, configuração de ambientes e pipelines de alto desempenho.
  • Git e CI/CD – Versionamento de código, integração e entrega contínua, configuração de pipelines de deploy (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline ou similares).


Habilidades Complementares:

  • Modelagem de dados – Entendimento de estruturas dimensionais, relacionais e não relacionais, normalização/desnormalização e boas práticas para ambientes analíticos.
  • ETL/ELT – Levantamento de requisitos, desenho e implementação de fluxos de extração, transformação e carga, com foco em qualidade e governança.
  • Boas práticas de segurança e compliance no ecossistema AWS (IAM, KMS, políticas de acesso, criptografia).
  • Integração de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos, streams).
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade de pipelines (CloudWatch, logs, métricas e alertas).
  • Documentação técnica clara e manutenção de repositórios de conhecimento.


Diferenciais:

title: IT Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, forward-thinking IT Specialist to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering month-to-month services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team so that we can continue to offer stellar service to our clients.


We don’t believe in binding our clients to a contract. We wow them every month with real results so that they want to keep coming back. We are a collective of creatives who come together every day to work towards the same goal: brand growth.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • A working level of spoken and written English
  • Proven experience in IT support, systems administration, or a similar role, preferably in a startup or fast-paced environment.
  • Deep knowledge of computer systems, networks, operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux), and cloud platforms (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365).
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills; ability to solve problems independently and communicate solutions clearly.
  • Experience with endpoint management, SaaS administration, and automation tools.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices, including MFA, VPNs, patch management, and incident response.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; ability to train and support non-technical users.

  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals (MS-900), or Google IT Support Professional Certificate are a plus.


Key Responsibilities


  • Install, configure, and maintain computer hardware, software, systems, and networks for all employees, both onsite and remote.

  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and other SaaS platforms.
  • Support the deployment and integration of new productivity and collaboration tools, including project management (e.g., Teamwork, ClickUp, Asana, Monday), internal tool builders, and AI-driven solutions.
  • Monitor and maintain endpoint security, including antivirus, firewalls, VPNs, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
  • Assist with cloud infrastructure management, data backup, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Conduct regular software updates, security patching, and vulnerability assessments.
  • Support cybersecurity initiatives, including employee security awareness training and incident response.
  • Document processes, create user guides, and train staff on new technologies and best practices.
  • Collaborate with leadership to evaluate and implement new tools that enhance productivity and security.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, apply today!

title: Senior Software Engineer – LLM / AI-Enabled Systems
description:
About Health Note

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid,disconnected software modules, ourassistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural,empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience forevery patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.


About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital

assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely andreliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empatheticexperience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfullyincorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at thefrontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

Within 6 Months:

Within 12 months:

  • Begin identifying areas for improvement in our codebase, researching best practices, and making recommendations to the team on strategies to address them

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience

The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

, HR & Resource Management

  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.

  • Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.

  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.

  • Experience: 8–12 years in senior leadership or country management, preferably in the IT/Consulting sector.

  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, business management platforms, and performance reporting tools.



Why Join Us?

  • Friendly, supportive, positive, and professional team of experts
  • Multicultural and diverse environment
  • Full-time employment
  • Remote work conditions

title: Analista de dados
description:
MISSÃO DO CARGO

Coletar, analisar e interpretar dados para fornecer insights estratégicos que apoiem a tomada de decisão em todos os níveis da empresa. Atuar na evolução da cultura de dados, garantindo a criação de análises robustas e painéis de controle estratégicos. Trabalhar em colaboração com diferentes áreas para garantir que os dados sejam precisos, confiáveis e transformados em insights acionáveis.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Coletar, processar e analisar dados de múltiplas fontes, garantindo a integridade e confiabilidade das informações;
  • Desenvolver modelos de análise de dados para identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos internos e estratégicos;
  • Construir e manter painéis de controle e relatórios gerenciais que apresentem insights relevantes para a empresa.
  • Monitorar e interpretar métricas-chave de desempenho (KPIs), transformando dados brutos em insights acionáveis para as partes interessadas;
  • Aplicar técnicas avançadas de análise de dados, incluindo modelagem preditiva, análise de séries temporais, machine learning e mineração de dados;
  • Identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades nos dados, fornecendo recomendações acionáveis para otimizar o processo de implantação, melhorar a qualidade e reduzir o tempo de ativação do cliente.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas para apoiar na identificação e implementação de melhorias baseadas em dados;
  • Garantir a evolução da maturidade analítica da organização, promovendo a disseminação das melhores práticas em análise de dados;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e tecnologias emergentes no campo da análise de dados, propondo soluções inovadoras para aprimorar a tomada de decisão;
  • Criar documentação e padronizar processos para garantir a governança e a qualidade dos dados utilizados em análises e relatórios.

CONHECIMENTOS E HABILIDADES

  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau, SenseData, Looker, etc.);
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação para análise de dados (Python, R, SQL);
  • Experiência em modelagem estatística, análise preditiva e machine learning;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Compreensão dos princípios de governança e qualidade de dados;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados complexos e gerar insights estratégicos;
  • Experiência na criação e automação de relatórios e dashboards.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.



WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base



REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.



WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability



READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.



Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

Competências Técnicas

  • Domínio Profundo do Ecossistema Java:
  • Java moderno: Spring Boot e ecossistema (security, data, etc.), Quarkus (desempenho), etc. para injeção de dependências, programação reativa, microsserviços, etc.
  • Java legado: Java EE (JSP, Servlets, EJB), Struts, JSF, etc. para manutenção, convivência, modernização, ,migração e/ou refatoração.

  • Desenho de soluções desacopladas, coesas e de fácil manutenção.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões arquiteturais importantes e justificar suas decisões com base em requisitos técnicos e/ou de negócio.
  • Especialista em padrões de projetos clássicos (GoF: Gang of Four) e para microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Expertise em Back-end e Visão Abrangente de Front-end:
  • Back-end: Java, DB (SQL: Oracle/SQL Sever, e NoSQL), mensageria (Kafka ou RabbitMQ), construção de APIs RESTful robustas e bem documentadas.
  • Front-end: é necessário conhecimento sólido dos fundamentos de front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React e Angular.
  • Cultura de DevOps e Automação:
  • Experiência em CI/CD com GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.
  • Conhecimento de conteinerização com: Kubernetes, Docker, Nexus, etc.
  • Experiência e espírito de testes automatizados: unitários, integração e performance.
  • Qualidade, Segurança e Manutenção:
  • Code review, análise estática e dinâmica de código (SONAR), avaliação de métricas de qualidade do codebase.
  • Mentalidade de “segurança desde a concepção” e no caso de manutenção “a intervenção mínima e segura que resolve o problema”, sem sub ou over engineering.


Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: Backend Cloud Engineer — AWS Serverless (Remote)
description:
Company Description

everup provides instant cashback on purchases of gift cards from top brands and offers the excitement of winning extra cashback through free and engaging games. Our mission is to extend consumer budgets during rising living costs, blending savings with enjoyment. We offer prize-linked digital branded prepayments and turn shopping into opportunities. everup is a unique gamified shopping experience in the branded prepaid and curated goods market, helping customers save money while bringing entertainment and excitement.


⦿ The role

You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile/Web.

What you’ll do

• Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway (HTTP/REST & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core; implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/HTTP.

• Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS); handle indexes, migrations, and query performance.

• Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms.

• Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions.

• Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling.

• Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks.

• Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability).


⦿ Tech you’ll touch

AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools).

Must-haves

• 8+ years building/maintaining production backends; 4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB).

• Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js; strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns.

• Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning).

• Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline).

• Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP).

• WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features.

• Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations.

• Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs.

• Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure.


⦿ How we work

Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability.

Hiring process

1. Intro call

2. Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution)

3. Practical walkthrough (IaC/API/data-modeling maintenance scenario)

4. Founder/lead chat & references

Equal opportunity

We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective.

How to apply


⦿ When applying, please include the following in your CV/application:

  • A link to your CV, GitHub, or portfolio.
  • A short note describing a production backend you maintained or evolved, and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.
  • Your current salary or expected monthly salary (in EUR).
  • Your notice period.
  • Confirmation of your availability to work at least 6 hours per day aligned with EU time zones .


⚠️ Applications that do not include the above details will not be considered.

Thank you for your interest — we look forward to your application!

Python. title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Backend Ops & Integrations Assistant
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

We’re seeking experienced, detail-oriented backend ops & integrations assistants to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog, but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re an effective problem-solver who’s always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.

  • You’re a team player.
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.

Your main responsibilities will include:

Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure + Elixir + Linux)
description:
DevOps / Distributed Systems Engineer (Azure • Elixir • Linux )


Who We Are Seeking:


We seek a talented and experienced DevOps/Distributed Systems Engineer to operate and harden our Elixir services and Hyperledger Besu node network on Microsoft Azure to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.


Your Role and Responsibilities:  


  • Run Besu on Azure: manage validators/peers, permissioning, bootnodes, IBFT/QBFT configs, genesis updates, hard-fork rollouts, and RPC/WS endpoints behind Azure gateways.
  • Storage & performance: size and tune Besu (JVM/RocksDB) with Premium SSD v2 / Ultra Disk, optimize IOPS/throughput, and implement snapshot/restore pipelines via Azure Blob Storage.
  • Networking: build secure, private networking with VNets, subnets, Azure CNI (Cilium), Network Security Groups, Private Endpoints/Private Link, NAT Gateway, and VNet peering/ExpressRoute as needed.
  • Traffic & ingress: expose RPC/WS endpoints through Azure Application Gateway or Nginx Ingress with Web Application Firewall (WAF), mTLS, rate limits, and IP allowlists.
  • Secrets & keys: manage validator keys and app secrets with Azure Key Vault / Managed HSM, Managed Identities, and least-privilege RBAC via Microsoft Entra ID.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: ship immutable releases using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, ACR (image signing/scan), Helm, and Argo CD (or Flux) for environment promotion.
  • Observability & SRE: wire up Azure Monitor + Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana (or self-managed Prometheus/Grafana), OpenTelemetry traces, Alert rules, runbooks, SLOs/error budgets.


Tech You’ll Use:


  • Blockchain: Hyperledger Besu (IBFT/QBFT, permissioning); Geth/Nethermind familiarity is a plus
  • Elixir: Elixir/OTP, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, OpenTelemetry
  • Azure: AKS, ACR, Azure Monitor & Log Analytics, Managed Prometheus/Grafana, Key Vault / Managed HSM, Application Gateway/WAF, NAT Gateway, NSG, Private Link, Azure Firewall, Blob Storage, Managed Disks (Premium v2/Ultra), Azure Backup/Site Recovery, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Entra ID
  • IaC & CI/CD: Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps
  • Logging/Tracing: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki/ELK (optional), OpenTelemetry


Essential Qualifications:  


  • 4+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform roles running distributed systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience operating EVM nodes (preferably Besu ) and tuning storage/IO, txpool, and pruning/archive modes.
  • Strong Azure background: AKS, VNet/NSG/Private Link, Key Vault, ACR, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, and Application Gateway/WAF.
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (TLS, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing).
  • Proven observability practice: metrics, logs, traces, actionable alerting, SLOs/runbooks.
  • Excellent written and spoken English (daily collaboration across teams).


Who We Are:


DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.


What We Offer:


  • Contract-based hiring;
  • Full-time opportunity (40 hours per week);
  • 100% remote work / home office;
  • Performance-based bonuses tied to achievements and deliverables;
  • Open and flexible time-off policy;
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment;
  • Equipment program;
  • Paid days off per year + holidays (variable) + recess days;
  • Sponsorship program for relevant courses and training.

description:

This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.

  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.

  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
